reviews.text:
This app is so annoying to shop. Half the stuff is delivery/shipping only, the rest is pickup only. I tried ordering a pretty standard item after getting a 20% coupon in the mail and of course, the only option is pick up and the max any store has near me is 37 cans. So no 20% off since it’s for $100+ and no order for Petco. Chewy, PetSmart, Petsupplies+, and Amazon all have it AND PetSmart also has a 20% coupon. 

Finally, the Petco rewards are stupid. They allow multiple sign ups with the same number and they only tell me I have to call a number to merge them. So “rewards” take about $5000 in spending to “earn” $5.

reviews.title: This app blows
reviews.text:
1. This app makes you upload a prescription and then never approve the food you need based on the prescription. Which then does not allow me to have automatic food delivery. 2. My dog passed away months ago, I memorialized her and even tried deleting the profile; yet she still appears each time I open the app. 3. The amount of glitches on this app is INSANE! You’ll be more successful on the phone with them for over an hour. You can’t upload prescriptions (given by them/their drs); You can’t edit or delete profiles; They make you jump through hoops just to set up automatic food deliveries. Very frustrating and unacceptable at this stage of technology. 

On a good note: The points system for discounts on food, and visits was worth it - especially if you have multiple pets. BUT you have to pay and sign up for their “membership”.

Recently, my dog passed on unexpectedly. He was only a pup about 4 years old. It just happened a couple days ago. His birthday is this month, and Petco sent him a coupon. Petco knows what pets I have because I have an account - you need one with the app I think. Well in the pet section of your account, there is the option to “edit” or “remove” a pet. Petco, I don’t want to remove my dog. I want him in my account. I want a feature where I can retire or memorialize my dog in my account, I will not hit a remove button. Please fix this. I think a lot of pet owners who lose a pet, they don’t want to hit that button. Thank you.

reviews.title: Auto ship
reviews.text:
After hearing about autoship I signed up what a horrible mistake that was. First delivery date was changed twice from original date shown in the Petco app not a huge issue since I still had food for my dogs. Second delivery was scheduled for August 19th the same day I was out of food for the dogs. As I waited so did my dogs… 3pm still no delivery by 6pm no food for my dogs! I checked the tracking for my delivery now it’s showing arriving August 20th. I jump in the car and go purchase enough to get us through August 20th date. On the 20th I checked tracking NEW delivery date 8/22 WTH.
I go back to Petco and by a small bag of dog food being inconvenience again is a horrible waste of my time not considering the safety of my pets. I’m not waiting for a book to arrive, I waiting for an essential item for my dogs. Call the store asking if I can pick up the items I had already paid for? nope! So not our problem call the 877 number was their solution for my starving dogs. No results from the 877 corporate number ( leave a message and we will return your call tomorrow) I have so much to say at this moment but I want to keep this PG-13 so I will end it here. What a waste of time, energy and money since I had to buy extra food while waiting using time and gas to compensate Petco “not our problem” approach

reviews.title: Abominable
reviews.text:
Update on 6/24/2026:
I tried six different times to order with items shown as clearly available each time I went back. So I swap them out for other items that were also shown as available. By the time I get to the checkout, I’m being told “sorry none of those items are available anymore. Please make a different choice”. Apparently Petco shelves are entirely empty…. 🤷‍♀️

The checkout process is so broken that I wonder how Petco makes any money other than from local foot traffic. They should hire an e-commerce expert. 
It starts with a broken  product selection:
“Sorry you must  select a delivery method” but there is no such option on the screen, anywhere I scroll. 
I tried the web app, but no luck there, either. Also, if an item is not available, I should be able to remove it from the cart during checkout yet I have to go all the way to the beginning. Navigation is atrocious and apparently nobody cares about the user experience. Couldn’t place an order… again.

reviews.title: Needs improvement
reviews.text: The app is ok.  The customer service is not great.  I ordered 4 boxes of cat litter and it never arrived.  I checked the tracking and it showed it made it to the town near me and then sent back to petco because it got damaged in route.  Ok Thats fine but I should have been notified I wasn’t getting my order.  I contacted customer service and they said to wait 7-10 days for my refund.  After 2 weeks of no refund I contacted them again through the chat feature on the app.  This time I got someone great.  She immediately refunded my money and gave me $15 towards a future purchase.   I reordered the litter and it kept getting delayed.  I finally got it a few days after the original delivery date that was given to me.  The litter was taped up from top to bottom on all 4 boxes. The handles were taped down so they couldn’t be carried.  The spout was taped down over the perforations so you couldn’t open it.  It was ridiculous.  I’ll pay more next time and order from somewhere better.
